purpose: Present ordered quantitative series as a line chart with shared loading, legend, tooltip and optional exact-data support.
behaviorProvider: Recharts Cartesian chart primitives and shared ChartContainer.

component: Delegate loading, error and empty presentation to ChartContainer; empty means no data or no series. Loading precedes error, error precedes empty, and the chart only renders in the remaining branch.
When showLegend is true, render real aria-pressed toggle buttons backed by local hidden-series keys. Toggling changes plotted visibility without removing records from the optional data table.

Enable the Recharts accessibility layer and name the plot with its title and arrow-key inspection instruction. Optionally expose a native disclosure containing exact stringified records in ChartDataTable.
host: Supply ordered records with stable series keys and numeric values matching xKey and each series key. The wrapper does not sort, fetch, aggregate or validate Cartesian values.

Enable showDataTable or provide an equivalent exact-data alternative when users need detailed values. Supply domain-appropriate title, units and formatters; default numeric labels use en-GB formatting.

requirements.statement: Supply ordered records with stable series keys and numeric values matching xKey and each series key. The wrapper does not sort, fetch, aggregate or validate Cartesian values.

Enable the Recharts accessibility layer and name the plot with its title and arrow-key inspection instruction. Optionally expose a native disclosure containing exact stringified records in ChartDataTable.
Render a brush only when enabled and data has more than one record. Pass brushRange indexes to Recharts and forward onBrushChange; no remote range filtering or data acquisition occurs here.

Enable showDataTable or provide an equivalent exact-data alternative when users need detailed values. Supply domain-appropriate title, units and formatters; default numeric labels use en-GB formatting.
Use ResponsiveContainer with token-backed initial geometry and resize debounce. Disable series and tooltip animation; preserve gaps by leaving connectNulls false for line and area.
Render monotone lines without persistent dots and with a token-sized active dot. The shared stacked prop does not create a stack for the line branch.
Consume data-viz group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: Legend visibility is local and is not controlled or persisted. Hidden-series keys are not automatically reset when data changes.
Input records and series values are not runtime-validated; missing, invalid and mismatched domain data require host review.
No chart-specific loading request, error recovery, pagination or telemetry is implemented.
